import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
...

/-! ## O4 `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Children of place `x` in index order (§63.2). -/
def kids (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range P.length).filter fun r => decide (parentOf P r = some x)

/-- Position of `r` in a list, its length if absent (§63.2). -/
def posIn (r : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: l => if a = r then 0 else posIn r l + 1

/-- `corr(r)` within `n` steps (§63.2): `dst` for `src`; for another part, the child at the same
position of the place corresponding to its parent. -/
def corrF (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Option Nat
  | 0, r => if r = src then some dst else none
  | n + 1, r => if r = src then some dst else
      match parentOf P r with
      | some p => if p < r then
          (corrF P src dst n p).bind fun p' => (kids P p')[posIn r (kids P p)]? else none
      | none => none

/-- `corr(r)` (§63.2, §63.8): the part of `dst` corresponding to the part `r` of `src`. -/
def corr (P : List Place) (src dst r : Nat) : Option Nat := corrF P src dst r r

/-- Same shape of ordered subtrees (§63.2): every part of `src` has a corresponding part of `dst`
with as many children, and every part of `dst` corresponds to a part of `src`. -/
def SameShape (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src →
    OptP (corr P src dst r) (fun r' => (kids P r').length = (kids P r).length) False) ∧
  ∀ z ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P z dst →
    ∃ r ∈ List.range P.length, partOf P r src ∧ corr P src dst r = some z

/-- Decidability of `SameShape` (§63.2). -/
instance (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (SameShape P src dst) := by
  unfold SameShape; infer_instance

/-- Holder within the value at `q` (§63, §69, §70): `q` or one of its parts. -/
def heldIn (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place r => partOf P r q
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `heldIn` (§63). -/
instance (P : List Place) (q : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (heldIn P q h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold heldIn <;> infer_instance

/-- Holder `h` after the transfer of `src` to `dst` (§63, `ok` effect): part `r` of `src` becomes
`corr(r)`. Applied to holders within `src` only. -/
def mvTo (P : List Place) (src dst : Nat) : Holder → Holder
  | .place r => .place ((corr P src dst r).getD dst)
  | .frame f => .frame f

/-- Anchors moved onto place `q` by the transfer (§63, `ok` effect, fourth item): those of every
part `r` of `src` with `corr(r) = q`. -/
def movedTo (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun r =>
    decide (partOf s.P r src ∧ corr s.P src dst r = some q)).flatMap s.D

/-- Effect of `transfer(source, destination)` (§63, `ok` effect): source leaves `Moved`,
destination leaves `Init`; authorities held by part `r` of `src`, and places owned by `r`, move
to `corr(r)`; the anchors of `r` follow `corr(r)`. -/
def transferEff (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    P := s.P.map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
      else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q src then [] else s.D q ++ movedTo s src dst q
    A := s.A.map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y }

/-- Active derived authority covering a leaf of `src` and not held within it (§63.4). -/
def ActiveDerivedOutside (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.origin ≠ none ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P src y.holder ∧
    ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ footprint s.P src) False

/-- Decidability of `ActiveDerivedOutside` (§63.4). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j : Nat) : Decidable (ActiveDerivedOutside s src j) := by
  unfold ActiveDerivedOutside; infer_instance

/-- The holder moves with the value at `src` (§63.6, §63.7): a part of `src` or storage it owns,
transitively. -/
def HolderMoves (s : S3) (src : Nat) : Holder → Prop
  | .place p => partOf s.P p src ∨ OwnedIn s.P src p
  | .frame _ => False

/-- Decidability of `HolderMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderMoves s src h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderMoves <;> infer_instance

/-- Authority `x` is a moved held authority (§63.7): its holder moves with the value at `src`. -/
def AnchorMoves (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[x]?) (fun y => HolderMoves s src y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `AnchorMoves` (§63.7). -/
instance (s : S3) (src x : Nat) : Decidable (AnchorMoves s src x) := by
  unfold AnchorMoves; infer_instance

/-- Dependencies of the usable places following the value at `src` (§63.6): the anchors of its
parts and of the usable storage it owns, transitively. -/
def movedDeps (s : S3) (src : Nat) : List Nat :=
  ((List.range s.P.length).filter fun q =>
    decide (partOf s.P q src ∨ (OwnedIn s.P src q ∧ s.Usable q))).flatMap s.D

/-- Leaves of a holder (§63.8): those of a place, none for a frame. -/
def holderLeaves (s : S3) : Holder → List Nat
  | .place p => footprint s.P p
  | .frame _ => []

/-- Authority `a` is active and covers a leaf of its own holder (§63.8). -/
def SelfLock (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ ∃ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∈ holderLeaves s y.holder) False

/-- Decidability of `SelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (SelfLock s a) := by unfold SelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Local self-blocking prevention (§63.8): no authority held before the step within `src` covers,
in the resulting state, a leaf of its new holder `corr(r)`. -/
def NoLocalSelfLock (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => heldIn s.P src y.holder) False →
    ¬ SelfLock (transferEff s src dst) j

/-- Decidability of `NoLocalSelfLock` (§63.8). -/
instance (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Decidable (NoLocalSelfLock s src dst) := by
  unfold NoLocalSelfLock; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
structure TransferPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §63.1: `source` is usable. -/
  srcUsable : s.Usable src
  /-- §63.1: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the source. -/
  srcRight : HasRight s .modify src
  /-- §63.1: exercisable `Modify` over the destination. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §63.2: same shape of ordered subtrees. -/
  sameShape : SameShape s.P src dst
  /-- §63.3: all source leaves are `Init`. -/
  srcInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init
  /-- §63.3: no destination leaf is `Init`. -/
  dstNotInit : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init
  /-- §63.3: source and destination footprints are disjoint. -/
  disjoint : ¬ overlap s.P src dst
  /-- §63.4: no active derived authority covers a source leaf from outside the source, except the
  authorities through which the step exercises its `Modify` right over the source: some authority
  grounding that right and its origin chain. -/
  noOutsideDerived : ∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
    ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j
  /-- §63.5: no in-place source leaf is pinned, statically or dynamically. -/
  notPinned : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false
  /-- §63.6: dependencies of the usable places following the value are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x
  /-- §63.6: `AnchorOrder` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst)
  /-- §63.7: every moved held authority satisfies `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
    ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
      OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
        EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True
  /-- §63.8: local self-blocking prevention. -/
  noSelfLock : NoLocalSelfLock s src dst
  /-- §63.9: `destination` is usable in the resulting state. -/
  dstUsableAfter : (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `transfer` (§63). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.Pinned] (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (TransferPre k s src dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable src ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ HasRight s .modify src ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ SameShape s.P src dst ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, s.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P dst, s.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s.P src dst ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s.A.length, Grounds s .modify src g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s src j → RightChain s g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P src, ¬ k.Pinned l ∧ s.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s src, s.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s src dst) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, AnchorMoves s src x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, (transferEff s src dst).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s src dst).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s src dst) x ((transferEff s src dst).pframe q)) True) ∧
    NoLocalSelfLock s src dst ∧ (transferEff s src dst).Usable dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩ =>
      ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p⟩⟩

/-- `transfer` as a relation (§63). -/
def TransferStep (k : K) (src dst : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (TransferPre k s src dst) (transferEff s src dst)

/-! ## O5 `depend` (§64) -/

....

/-! ## O9 `read`, O10 `write`, O11 `writeShared` (§66–§68) -/

/-- Leaf `l` belongs to a usable place (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1). -/
def LeafOfUsable (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-- Decidability of `LeafOfUsable` (§66.1). -/
instance (s : S3) (l : Nat) : Decidable (LeafOfUsable s l) := by
  unfold LeafOfUsable; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `read` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§66). The type and storage
contract of §66.3 is not represented. -/
structure Read3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read belongs to a usable place. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §66.1: every leaf read is `Init`. -/
  init : ∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init
  /-- §66.2: `access` is exercisable in `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §66.2: the effective mode of `access` permits observation of each leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §66.3: required anchors are valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `read` (§66). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Read3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, s.I l = .init) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `read` as a relation (§66): the state is unchanged. -/
def Read3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Read3Pre s a ls) s

/-- Preconditions of an ordinary `write` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§67). The type,
storage and abstraction constraints of §67.3 are not represented. -/
structure Write3Pre (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §67.1: targeted leaves belong to usable places. -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §67.1: `access` is exercisable in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .modify
  /-- §67.1: `access` has effective `Modify` over each leaf. -/
  effectiveModify : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify
  /-- §67.2: no other authority holds an effective mode, all incompatible with `Modify` (§50),
  over the written leaves. -/
  exclusive : ∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none
  /-- §67.3: anchors remain valid. -/
  anchorsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `write` (§67). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Decidable (Write3Pre s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ s.ExercisableAt a .modify ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, b ≠ a → effective s b l = none) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- Effect of a write (§67, §68, `ok` effect): the written leaves become `Init`. -/
def write3Eff (s : S3) (ls : List Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with I := fun p => if p ∈ ls then .init else s.I p }

/-- `write` as a relation (§67). -/
def Write3Step (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (Write3Pre s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

/-- Preconditions of `writeShared` of the leaves `ls` through `access` (§68). -/
structure WriteSharedPre (k : K) (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is usable (belongs to a usable place). -/
  usable : ∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l
  /-- §68.1: every leaf of the region is declared `K.SharedMutable`. -/
  shared : ∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l
  /-- §68.2: `access` is exercisable in a mode at least `Observe`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt a .observe
  /-- §68.2: `access` has a present effective mode on every leaf. -/
  effectivePresent : ∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none
  /-- §68.3: dependencies are valid. -/
  depsValid : ∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `writeShared` (§68). -/
instance (k : K) [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable] (s : S3) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) :
    Decidable (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) :=
  decidable_of_iff ((∀ l ∈ ls, LeafOfUsable s l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, k.SharedMutable l) ∧
    s.ExercisableAt a .observe ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, effective s a l ≠ none) ∧ (∀ l ∈ ls, DepsValid s l))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `writeShared` as a relation (§68). -/
def WriteSharedStep (k : K) (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (WriteSharedPre k s a ls) (write3Eff s ls)

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Ops

/-!
# Access kernel: invariants, initial state, reachability

Invariants of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`: `WF3` (§49), `I1`–`I4` (§50–§53),
`NoDangling` and `NoOrphan` (§54), `Inv3` and `I5` (§57), the declared statics and `S3.init`
(§47), `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75), and reachability from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps
O1–O16 (§57). `AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` (§44) are in
`Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic`, since operations read them.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Root places and root authorities (§40, §49) -/

/-- Root place (§40): an existing place with no structural parent. -/
def RootPlace (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Prop := r < P.length ∧ parentOf P r = none

/-- Decidability of `RootPlace` (§40). -/
instance (P : List Place) (r : Nat) : Decidable (RootPlace P r) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ ∧ _))

/-- `RootChain` (§49.6): the origin chain of an authority covering a leaf ends at a root
authority (no origin) whose footprint is the footprint of a root place containing that leaf. -/
def RootChain (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s.A[a]? = some y → l ∈ y.footprint → isLeaf s.P l →
    ∃ x z r, (x = a ∨ x ∈ s.ancs a) ∧ s.A[x]? = some z ∧ z.origin = none ∧ RootPlace s.P r ∧
      partOf s.P l r ∧ ∀ l', l' ∈ z.footprint ↔ l' ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- `RootHeld` (§49.7, §40): every usable root place has an active root authority of own mode
`Modify`, with no origin, held by the owner of the place, whose footprint is the footprint of the
place. -/
def RootHeld (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ r, RootPlace s.P r → s.Usable r → ∃ (i : Nat) (z : Authority) (pr : Place),
    s.A[i]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ z.origin = none ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
    s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner ∧ ∀ l, l ∈ z.footprint ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P r

/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's, the derived footprint is within the origin's, and the origin of an active derived
authority is valid, that is, active. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ (∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint) ∧
      (y.active = true → x.active = true)

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

/-- `I5` (§57): every pinned leaf, statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (an active pinning
obligation, §74), belongs to a usable place. The quantifier ranges over the leaves of the state
(§40): `K.Pinned` on an index that is not a leaf of `s` is not constrained. A specialized
obligation of `K.Pinned`, not a conjunct of the main invariant (§57). -/
def I5 (k : K) (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ l, l < s.P.length → isLeaf s.P l → (k.Pinned l ∨ s.pin l = true) →
    ∃ q, s.Usable q ∧ l ∈ footprint s.P q

/-! ## `NoOrphan` (§54) -/

/-- One link of a `NoOrphan` chain (§54): `a` is active and structurally covers every leaf of the
place holding `b`. -/
def CoversHolder (s : S3) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun z => match z.holder with
    | .place q => s.Active a ∧ ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∈ s.afp a
    | .frame _ => False) False

/-- Consecutive elements of a list are related by `R` (§54, chains of `NoOrphan`). -/
def Linked (R : Nat → Nat → Prop) : List Nat → Prop
  | a :: b :: c => R a b ∧ Linked R (b :: c)
  | _ => True

/-- `NoOrphan` (§54): every active authority held by a place ends a finite, non-repeating chain of
authorities whose first link is active and held by a frame of the stack, each link covering the
whole place holding the next. -/
def NoOrphan (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (q : Nat), s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
    ∃ (a₀ : Nat) (z : Authority) (f : Nat) (c : List Nat), s.A[a₀]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧
      z.holder = .frame f ∧ f ∈ s.F ∧ (a₀ :: c).Nodup ∧ (a₀ :: c).getLast? = some x ∧
      Linked (CoversHolder s) (a₀ :: c)

/-! ## Initial state (§47) -/

/-- Declared static storage (§47): each element is (parent, owning static, kind) with its
initial state, `true` for `Init` and `false` for `Uninit` (read on leaves only). -/
abbrev Statics := List ((Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat) × Bool)

/-- Well-formed statics declaration (§47: the ownership graph of statics is acyclic; §49, last
paragraph: the ordering of identifiers represents this well-foundedness, and that of structural
parents): parents and owning statics are earlier statics, and a part has its parent's owning
static (§49.2). -/
def StaticsOK (statics : Statics) : Prop := ShapeOK 0 (statics.map (·.1))

/-- Decidability of `StaticsOK` (§47). -/
instance (statics : Statics) : Decidable (StaticsOK statics) := by
  unfold StaticsOK; infer_instance

/-- `S3.init statics` (§47): base frame 0 and the declared statics, owned by frame 0 or by
another static; one root `Modify` authority with no origin per root static, held by its owner;
leaves `Init` or `Uninit` as declared; no anchor, no derived authority, nothing dead, no
dynamic pinning obligation. -/
def S3.init (statics : Statics) : S3 :=
  { F := [0]
    nF := 1
    P := shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))
    I := fun l => if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then .init else .uninit
    A := (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1))).map fun i =>
      ⟨.modify, none, footprint (shapeP [] (.frame 0) (statics.map (·.1))) i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩
    D := fun _ => []
    dead := fun _ => false
    pins := [] }

/-- `StaticPinnedBottom` (§75, §80): every static place whose leaf is designated by `K.Pinned` is
directly owned by the base frame 0. A condition on `(K, statics)`. -/
def StaticPinnedBottom (k : K) (statics : Statics) : Prop :=
  ∀ l < statics.length, k.Pinned l →
    OptP ((S3.init statics).P[l]?) (fun pl => pl.owner = .frame 0) False

/-! ## Reachability (§57) -/

/-- States reachable from `S3.init statics` under the kernel steps O1–O16 (§57). -/
inductive Reachable (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  | init : Reachable k statics (S3.init statics)
  | step {s s' : S3} : Reachable k statics s → KStep k s s' → Reachable k statics s'

/-! ## Non-vacuity examples (§47, §60–§75)

Each operation has an accepting state, decided by `decide` on concrete states built from
`S3.init`; a few rejections are included. -/

namespace Examples

/-- Test contract (§48): nothing declared disjoint or pinned, every leaf `SharedMutable`, every
external use done, every place deallocable, every request satisfiable. -/
def K0 : K := ⟨fun _ _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => False, fun _ => True, fun _ => True,
  fun _ _ => True, fun _ _ _ => True⟩

/-- Decidability of `K0.DeclaredDisjoint` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ r r', Decidable (K0.DeclaredDisjoint r r') :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.SharedMutable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.SharedMutable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Pinned` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Pinned := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable False)
/-- Decidability of `K0.ExternalDone` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.ExternalDone := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.Deallocable` (§48). -/
instance : DecidablePred K0.Deallocable := fun _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)
/-- Decidability of `K0.FreeCompat` (§48). -/
instance : ∀ p a, Decidable (K0.FreeCompat p a) := fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable True)

/-- Three static leaves owned by frame 0 (§47): place 0 `Init`, places 1 and 2 `Uninit`. -/
def st : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), false), ((none, none, 0), false)]

/-- `S3.init st` (§47). -/
def s0 : S3 := S3.init st
/-- After `derive(0, [0], Modify)` (§60): authority 3 held by frame 0. -/
def s1 : S3 := deriveEff s0 0 [0] .modify
/-- After `alloc(provider 0, owner 1, one leaf)` (§71): place 3 owned by place 1, root 3. -/
def s2 : S3 := allocEff s0 1 [(none, 0)]
/-- After `derive(1, [1], Modify)` then `store(3, 0)` (§60, §65): authority 3 on leaf 1 stored in
place 0. -/
def s3 : S3 := storeEff (deriveEff s0 1 [1] .modify) 3 0
/-- After `pin(0)` (§74): obligation 0 pins leaf 0. -/
def s4 : S3 := pinEff s0 0

example : StaticsOK st := by decide
example : DerivePre s0 0 [0] .modify := by decide
example : SplitPre K0 s0 0 [[0]] := by decide
example : ReleasePre s1 3 := by decide
example : TransferPre K0 s0 0 1 := by decide
example : ¬ TransferPre K0 s0 1 0 := by decide
example : DependPre s1 2 3 := by decide
example : EnterPre s1 [3] [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
example : StorePre s1 3 1 := by decide
example : ¬ ExitPre K0 s0 := by decide
example : Read3Pre s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : Write3Pre s0 1 [1] := by decide
example : WriteSharedPre K0 s0 0 [0] := by decide
example : EndUsePre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : FreePre K0 s2 3 0 := by decide
example : AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (some 3, 0)] := by decide
example : ¬ AllocStatic K0 s0 0 1 [(none, 0), (none, 0)] := by decide
example : PinPre s0 0 := by decide
example : UnpinPre K0 s4 0 := by decide
example : ¬ UnpinPre K0 s0 0 := by decide
example : ¬ EndUsePre K0 s4 0 := by decide

/-- §75: `unpin` ends only the designated obligation; with two obligations on leaf 0, ending
obligation 0 leaves the leaf pinned by obligation 1. -/
example : (unpinEff (pinEff s4 0) 0).pin 0 = true ∧ (unpinEff s4 0).pin 0 = false := by decide

/-- §63.8 decides alone: in `s3`, the transfer of place 0 to place 1 satisfies §63.1–§63.7 and
§63.9 and is rejected by local self-blocking prevention. -/
example : (s3.Usable 0 ∧ s3.Usable 1 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight s3 .modify 1 ∧
    SameShape s3.P 0 1 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, s3.I l = .init) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 1, s3.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap s3.P 0 1 ∧
    (∃ g ∈ List.range s3.A.length, Grounds s3 .modify 0 g ∧
      ∀ j ∈ List.range s3.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside s3 0 j → RightChain s3 g j) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s3.P 0, ¬ K0.Pinned l ∧ s3.pin l = false) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ movedDeps s3 0, s3.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder (transferEff s3 0 1) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ List.range s3.A.length, AnchorMoves s3 0 x →
      ∀ q ∈ List.range s3.P.length, (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable q →
        OptP ((transferEff s3 0 1).A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
          EffAnchorOK (transferEff s3 0 1) x ((transferEff s3 0 1).pframe q)) True) ∧
    (transferEff s3 0 1).Usable 1) ∧
    ¬ NoLocalSelfLock s3 0 1 ∧ ¬ TransferPre K0 s3 0 1 := by decide

end Examples

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) by every step, `transfer` (§63) included, from states satisfying
  `KInv` and the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`; preservation of the auxiliaries `KAux` and
  `HeldAnchored` by every step; preservation of `I5` (§57) by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant and the auxiliaries under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its
  `Init` leaves are the declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57, `reachable_kinv`) and `I5` on reachable states
  (`reachable_i5`); the ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9
  (`reachable_cycle_rejected`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
inductive KernelOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)

    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- `KInv` (§57) and the auxiliaries `KAux` and `HeldAnchored` (not clauses of §57) hold on every
state reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound` (§80), for well-formed statics
(`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
theorem reachable_inv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    exact ⟨kstep_preserves hdd ih.1 ih.2.2 h, kstep_preserves_kAux ih.1 ih.2.1 h,
      kstep_preserves_heldAnchored ih.1.1 ih.2.2 h⟩

/-- The main invariant of §57: on states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`
(§80), `WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan` holds, for well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`,
§47). -/
theorem reachable_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : KInv s :=
  (reachable_inv hdd hst h).1

/-- `I5` (§57) on reachable states: under `DDSound` (§80) and `StaticsOK` (§47), every leaf
pinned statically (`K.Pinned`) or by an active obligation (§74) belongs to a usable place in every
reachable state. No hypothesis on `K.Pinned`: initially every static is usable (§47) and a leaf
lies in its own footprint (§40). -/
theorem reachable_i5 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : Reachable k statics s) : I5 k s := by
  induction h with
  | init =>
    intro l hlt hleaf _
    exact ⟨l, init_usable hst (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) (by rwa [initP_len] at hlt),
      mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlt, hleaf, hlt, .inl rfl⟩⟩
  | step hr h ih => exact kstep_preserves_i5 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).1 ih h

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9: `cyc2` is reachable under a contract
with `DDSound` (§80), `transfer(0, 3)` from it is rejected because its destination would not be
usable, and the resulting state of that transfer, which violates `KInv` (§49.8, §54), is not
reachable (§57). -/

theorem chainF_root {org : Nat → Option Nat} : ∀ k i r r', r ∈ chainF org k i → org r = none →
    r' ∈ chainF org k i → org r' = none → r = r'
  | 0, _, _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp [chainF] at h
  | k + 1, i, r, r', h, hr, h', hr' => by
    simp only [chainF] at h h'; split at h
    · rename_i o ho; simp only [ho] at h'
      split at h
      · rename_i hlt; simp only [hlt, ↓reduceIte] at h'
        rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h <;> rcases List.mem_cons.1 h' with rfl | h'
        · rfl
        · rw [chainF_none hr] at h'; simp at h'
        · rw [chainF_none hr'] at h; simp at h
        · exact chainF_root k _ r r' h hr h' hr'
      · simp at h
    · simp at h

/-- A chain contains the chain of each of its elements, for links to smaller indices (§40, §42,
§49). -/
theorem chain_trans {org : Nat → Option Nat} (hlt : ∀ i o, org i = some o → o < i) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → ∀ r, r ∈ chain org i → ∀ o ∈ chain org r, o ∈ chain org i
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hi, r, hr, o, ho => by
    cases hp : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none hp] at hr; simp at hr
    | some p =>
      have hpi := hlt i p hp
      rw [chain_cons hp hpi] at hr ⊢
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ho
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (chain_trans hlt n p (by omega) r hr o ho)

/-- An element of a chain is the link of the start or belongs to the chain of that link (§40,
§42). -/
theorem mem_chain {org : Nat → Option Nat} {i x : Nat} (h : x ∈ chain org i) :
    ∃ o, org i = some o ∧ o < i ∧ (x = o ∨ x ∈ chain org o) := by
  cases ho : org i with
  | none => rw [chain_none ho] at h; simp at h
  | some o =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge o i with hlt | hge
    · rw [chain_cons ho hlt] at h; exact ⟨o, rfl, hlt, List.mem_cons.1 h⟩
    · exfalso
      cases i with
      | zero => simp [chain, chainF] at h
      | succ k => simp [chain, chainF, ho, Nat.not_lt.2 hge] at h

/-! ## Footprints and frames of places (§40) -/

/-- Membership in `footprint(q)` (§40): an existing leaf that is a part of `q`. -/
theorem mem_footprint {P : List Place} {q l : Nat} :
    l ∈ footprint P q ↔ l < P.length ∧ isLeaf P l ∧ partOf P l q := by
  simp [footprint, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range]

/-- Footprints depend only on the number of places and on structural parents (§40). -/
theorem footprint_congr {P P' : List Place} (hlen : P'.length = P.length)
    (hpar : parentOf P' = parentOf P) (q : Nat) : footprint P' q = footprint P q := by
  unfold footprint; rw [hlen]; congr 1; funext l
  exact decide_eq_decide.2 (by simp only [isLeaf, partOf, hpar, hlen])

/-- The frame of a place is unique (§40, `placeFrame`). -/
theorem FrameOf.det {s : S3} {q f f' : Nat} (h : FrameOf s q f) (h' : FrameOf s q f') :
    f = f' := by

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Cases 2 and 4 of §43: a present effective mode is the own mode when no active descendant
covers the leaf, `Observe` when only `Observe` descendants do. -/
theorem effOf_cases {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : effOf m ds = some m') :
    (ds = [] ∧ m' = m) ∨ (ds ≠ [] ∧ Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
  unfold effOf at h
  by_cases h0 : ds = []
  · simp [h0] at h; exact .inl ⟨h0, h.symm⟩
  · by_cases h1 : Mode.modify ∈ ds
    · simp [h0, h1] at h
    · simp [h0, h1] at h; exact .inr ⟨h0, h1, h.symm⟩

/-- A mode other than `Modify` is `Observe` (§42). -/
theorem mode_eq_observe {m : Mode} (h : m ≠ .modify) : m = .observe := by cases m <;> simp_all

/-- Membership in `descModes` (§43): the mode of an active descendant covering the leaf. -/
theorem mem_descModes {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} :
    m ∈ descModes s a p ↔ ∃ j y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ y.active = true ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧
      a ∈ s.ancs j ∧ y.mode = m := by
  simp only [descModes, List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, -, h⟩
    split at h
    · rename_i y hy
      split at h
      · rename_i hc; cases h; exact ⟨j, y, hy, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2, rfl⟩
      · cases h
    · cases h
  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨j, (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 hy).1, ?_⟩
    simp [hy, h1, h2, h3]

/-- A present effective mode (§43, case 1): the authority is active and covers the leaf. -/
theorem effective_some {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} (h : effective s a p = some m) :
    ∃ x, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ x.active = true ∧ p ∈ x.footprint ∧
      effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) = some m := by
  unfold effective at h
  split at h
  · rename_i x hx; split at h
    · rename_i hc; exact ⟨x, hx, hc.1, hc.2, h⟩
    · cases h
  · cases h

/-- The effective mode of an active authority covering the leaf (§43, cases 2–4). -/
theorem effective_eq {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (ha : x.active = true) (hp : p ∈ x.footprint) :
    effective s a p = effOf x.mode (descModes s a p) := by
  simp [effective, hx, ha, hp]

/-- The mode order is reflexive (§43). -/
theorem Mode.le_refl (m : Mode) : m.le m := by cases m <;> simp [Mode.le]

/-- The effective mode does not exceed the own mode (§43). -/
theorem effective_le {s : S3} {a p : Nat} {m : Mode} {x : Authority} (hx : s.A[a]? = some x)
    (h : effective s a p = some m) : m.le x.mode := by
  obtain ⟨x', hx', -, -, he⟩ := effective_some h
  rw [hx] at hx'; cases hx'
  rcases effOf_cases he with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩
  · exact Mode.le_refl _
  · simp [Mode.le]

/-- The mode order is transitive (§43). -/
theorem Mode.le_trans {a b c : Mode} (h₁ : a.le b) (h₂ : b.le c) : a.le c := by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp_all [Mode.le]

/-- Only `Observe` is below `Observe` (§43). -/
theorem Mode.le_observe {m : Mode} (h : m.le .observe) : m = .observe := by
  cases m <;> simp_all [Mode.le]

/-- A mode permitted by a present effective mode (§43): below the own mode when no active
descendant covers the leaf, `Observe` when no `Modify` descendant does. -/
theorem allows_effOf {m m' : Mode} {ds : List Mode} (h : Allows (effOf m ds) m') :
    (ds = [] ∧ m'.le m) ∨ (Mode.modify ∉ ds ∧ m' = .observe) := by
  unfold Allows OptP at h
  split at h
  · rename_i e he
    rcases effOf_cases he with ⟨h0, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · exact .inl ⟨h0, h⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨hn, Mode.le_observe h⟩
  · exact h.elim

/-! ## Grounding of a right (§43, §63.4, §69.2, §70.3) -/

/-- `HasRight(s, m, q)` holds exactly when some authority grounds it (§43; §63.4, §69.2,
§70.3). -/
theorem hasRight_iff_grounds {s : S3} {m : Mode} {q : Nat} :
    HasRight s m q ↔ ∃ g, Grounds s m q g :=
  ⟨fun ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩ => ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩, fun ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩ => ⟨g, hg, he, hl⟩⟩

/-! ## Consequences of `I1` (§50) -/

/-- Under `I1`, two distinct authorities with present effective modes on a leaf have compatible
effective modes, `Observe`/`Observe` (§50, second paragraph). -/
theorem effective_compat {s : S3} (h : I1 s) :
    ∀ a b p m₁ m₂, a ≠ b → effective s a p = some m₁ → effective s b p = some m₂ →
      Compat m₁ m₂ := by
  intro a b p m₁ m₂ hab ha hb
  obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, xp, ex⟩ := effective_some ha
  obtain ⟨y, hy, ya, yp, ey⟩ := effective_some hb
  have obs₁ : x.mode = .observe → m₁ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  have obs₂ : y.mode = .observe → m₂ = .observe := fun hm => by
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ <;> simp [hm]
  by_cases hba : b ∈ s.ancs a
  · have hm : x.mode ∈ descModes s b p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨a, x, hx, xa, xp, hba, rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ey with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : x.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨obs₁ this, rfl⟩
  by_cases hab' : a ∈ s.ancs b
  · have hm : y.mode ∈ descModes s a p := mem_descModes.2 ⟨b, y, hy, ya, yp, hab', rfl⟩
    rcases effOf_cases ex with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, hn, rfl⟩
    · simp [h0] at hm
    · have : y.mode = .observe := mode_eq_observe fun e => hn (e ▸ hm)
      exact ⟨rfl, obs₂ this⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := h a b x y p hab hx hy xa ya xp yp hab' hba
  exact ⟨obs₁ h₁, obs₂ h₂⟩

/-- `effective_exclusive` (§50): under `I1`, an authority with effective `Modify` on a leaf is the
only one with a present effective mode there. -/
theorem effective_exclusive {s : S3} (h : I1 s) {a b p : Nat} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : effective s a p = some .modify) : effective s b p = none := by
  cases hb : effective s b p with
  | none => rfl
  | some m => exact absurd (effective_compat h a b p _ _ hab ha hb).1 (by simp)

/-- Compatibility of effective modes is symmetric (§50). -/
theorem Compat.symm {m₁ m₂ : Mode} (h : Compat m₁ m₂) : Compat m₂ m₁ := ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

/-- `I4` holds in every state (§53, first sentence): a read requires `Init` on every leaf read
(§66.1). -/
theorem i4_always (s : S3) : I4 s := fun _ _ l hl hm h => by rw [h.init l hl] at hm; cases hm

/-! ## Consequences of `I2` (§51) -/

/-- Under `I2`, the origin of an active derived authority is active (§51). -/
theorem I2.origin_active {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) {b a : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hb : s.A[b]? = some y) (ho : y.origin = some a) (ya : y.active = true) : s.Active a := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, -, -, hxa⟩ := h2 b y a hb ho; exact ⟨x, hx, hxa ya⟩

/-- Under `I2`, every authority of the origin chain of an active authority below `n` is active
(§51; §44, §60.1). -/
theorem I2.ancs_active_lt {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) :
    ∀ n j, j < n → s.Active j → ∀ x ∈ s.ancs j, s.Active x
  | 0, _, h, _, _, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, j, hj, ⟨y, hy, ya⟩, x, hx => by
    obtain ⟨o, ho, hlt, hx⟩ := mem_chain hx
    have hoa : s.Active o := h2.origin_active hy (by simpa [S3.org, hy] using ho) ya
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hoa
    · exact I2.ancs_active_lt h2 n o (by omega) hoa x hx

/-- Under `I2`, every authority of the origin chain of an active authority, its effective anchor
included, is active (§51; §44, §60.1). -/
theorem I2.ancs_active {s : S3} (h2 : I2 s) {j : Nat} (hj : s.Active j) :
    ∀ x ∈ s.ancs j, s.Active x :=
  h2.ancs_active_lt (j + 1) j (Nat.lt_succ_self j) hj

/-! ## Additions of authorities (§42, §60, §61) -/

/-- A list whose members are none is empty (§43, §63.2). -/
theorem nil_of_forall_not_mem {α : Type} : ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a, a ∉ l) → l = []
  | [], _ => rfl
def skel (z : Authority) : Mode × Option Nat × List Nat × Bool :=
  (z.mode, z.origin, z.footprint, z.active)

/-- `s'` has the authorities of `s` up to their holders (§42; §63: a transfer creates and
duplicates no authority). -/
def SameSkel (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  s'.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ j : Nat, (s'.A[j]?).map skel = (s.A[j]?).map skel

/-- An authority of `s'` has a counterpart in `s` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hj : s'.A[j]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y, rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- An authority of `s` has a counterpart in `s'` with the same skeleton (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.get' {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {j : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hj : s.A[j]? = some y) : ∃ y', s'.A[j]? = some y' ∧ skel y' = skel y := by
  have := h.2 j; rw [hj] at this
  cases hy : s'.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at this; cases this
  | some y' => rw [hy] at this; exact ⟨y', rfl, Option.some.inj this⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin links (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.org {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.org = s.org := by
  funext j
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none =>
    cases hy' : s'.A[j]? with
    | none => simp [S3.org, hy, hy']
    | some y' => obtain ⟨y, h1, -⟩ := h.get hy'; rw [hy] at h1; cases h1
  | some y => obtain ⟨y', hy', e⟩ := h.get' hy; simp [skel] at e; simp [S3.org, hy, hy', e.2.1]

/-- Same skeletons give the same origin chains (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.ancs {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') : s'.ancs = s.ancs := by
  funext j; simp [S3.ancs, h.org]

/-- Same skeletons give the same active authorities (§42). -/
theorem SameSkel.active {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {x : Nat} :
    s'.Active x ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩; obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := h.get hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by simp [skel] at he; rw [← he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩; obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by simp [skel] at he; rw [he.2.2.2]; exact ha⟩

/-- Same skeletons give the same covering descendants (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.descModes {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    descModes s' a p = descModes s a p := by
  unfold Access.descModes; rw [h.1, h.ancs]
  refine filterMap_congr' fun j _ => ?_
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => have := h.2 j; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[j]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- Same skeletons give the same effective modes (§43). -/
theorem SameSkel.effective {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' a p = effective s a p := by
  unfold Access.effective; rw [h.descModes]
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => have := h.2 a; rw [hy] at this; cases hy' : s'.A[a]? <;> simp_all
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', he⟩ := h.get' hy
    simp [skel] at he; simp [hy', he]

/-- `I1` depends only on the skeletons (§50). -/
theorem SameSkel.i1 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h1 : I1 s) : I1 s' := by
  intro a b x' y' p hab ha hb xa ya xp yp hnab hnba
  obtain ⟨x, hx, ex⟩ := h.get ha; obtain ⟨y, hy, ey⟩ := h.get hb
  simp [skel] at ex ey; rw [h.ancs] at hnab hnba
  rw [ex.1, ey.1]
  exact h1 a b x y p hab hx hy (ex.2.2.2 ▸ xa) (ey.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (ex.2.2.1 ▸ xp) (ey.2.2.1 ▸ yp)
    hnab hnba

/-- `I2` depends only on the skeletons (§51). -/
theorem SameSkel.i2 {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') (h2 : I2 s) : I2 s' := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hm, hh, ha⟩ := h2 b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)
  obtain ⟨x', hx', e'⟩ := h.get' hx₀; simp [skel] at e'
  exact ⟨x', hx', by rw [e.1, e'.1]; exact hm,
    fun p hp => by rw [e'.2.2.1]; exact hh p (e.2.2.1 ▸ hp),
    fun ya => by rw [e'.2.2.2]; exact ha (e.2.2.2 ▸ ya)⟩

/-- The origin clause of `WF3` depends only on the skeletons (§49.5). -/
theorem SameSkel.origins {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s')
    (hw : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b) :
    ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s'.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b := by
  intro b y a hb ho
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := h.get hb; simp [skel] at e
  exact hw b y₀ a hy₀ (e.2.1 ▸ ho)

/-- A property of every footprint member depends only on the skeletons (§49.4). -/
theorem SameSkel.footprints {s s' : S3} (h : SameSkel s s') {Q : Nat → Prop}
    (hw : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l) :
    ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s'.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint, Q l := by
  intro a x hx l hl
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, e⟩ := h.get hx; simp [skel] at e
    · cases ho
      exact ⟨x, by rw [addAuth_lt hs]; exact hx, hm, hfp, fun _ => hxa⟩

/-! ## Shape of `transfer` (§63) -/

/-- Places after a transfer: owners within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst` (§63,
`ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_P_get (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P[q]? = (s.P[q]?).map fun pl =>
      if heldIn s.P src pl.owner then { pl with owner := mvTo s.P src dst pl.owner } else pl := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- Authorities after a transfer: holders within `src` move to the corresponding part of `dst`
(§63, `ok` effect). -/
theorem transfer_A_get (s : S3) (src dst j : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
      if heldIn s.P src y.holder then { y with holder := mvTo s.P src dst y.holder } else y := by
  simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the number of places (§63). -/
theorem transfer_len (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    (transferEff s src dst).P.length = s.P.length := by simp [transferEff]

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parents (§63). -/
theorem transfer_parentOf (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    parentOf (transferEff s src dst).P = parentOf s.P := by
  funext i; simp only [parentOf, transfer_P_get]
  cases s.P[i]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some pl => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some]; split <;> rfl

/-- A transfer keeps the footprints (§63). -/
theorem transfer_footprint (s : S3) (src dst q : Nat) :
    footprint (transferEff s src dst).P q = footprint s.P q :=
  footprint_congr (transfer_len s src dst) (transfer_parentOf s src dst) q

/-- A transfer keeps the structural parts (§63). -/
theorem transfer_partOf (s : S3) (src dst r q : Nat) :
    partOf (transferEff s src dst).P r q ↔ partOf s.P r q := by
  simp only [partOf, transfer_parentOf, transfer_len]

/-- Membership in the children of a place (§63.2). -/
theorem mem_kids {P : List Place} {x r : Nat} :
/-- After a transfer, a part of `dst` has the frame of `dst` (§40, §63). -/
theorem transfer_pframe_part {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {src dst r' : Nat} (hr' : partOf s.P r' dst) :
    (transferEff s src dst).pframe r' = (transferEff s src dst).pframe dst := by
  obtain ⟨pd, pr, hpd, hpr, ho⟩ := transfer_owner_part (src := src) hw hr'
  exact pframe_eq_of_owner hpd hpr ho

/-- A transfer creates and duplicates no authority: it changes holders only (§63, §53). -/
theorem transfer_skel (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) : SameSkel s (transferEff s src dst) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [transferEff], fun j => ?_⟩

  cases s.A[j]? with
  | none => rfl
  | some y => simp only [Option.map_some]; split <;> rfl

theorem transfer_usable_back {s : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hwf : WF3 s) (hsrc : s.Usable src)

/-! ## Guarded transitions (§58) -/

/-- A guarded transition has one outcome (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.det {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} {o₁ o₂ : Outcome3 σ}
    (h₁ : Guarded Pre eff o₁) (h₂ : Guarded Pre eff o₂) : o₁ = o₂ := by
  cases h₁ <;> cases h₂ <;> first | rfl | contradiction

/-- The `ok` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions hold and the state is the effect
(§58). -/
theorem Guarded.ok_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff s' : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff (.ok s') ↔ Pre ∧ s' = eff :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; exact ⟨‹_›, rfl⟩, fun ⟨h, e⟩ => e ▸ .ok h⟩

/-- The `reject` outcome of a guarded transition: the preconditions fail (§58). -/
theorem Guarded.reject_iff {σ : Type} {Pre : Prop} {eff : σ} :
    Guarded Pre eff .reject ↔ ¬ Pre :=
  ⟨fun h => by cases h; assumption, fun h => .reject h⟩

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Cases 2 and 4 of §43: a present effective mode is the own mode when no active descendant
covers the leaf, `Observe` when only `Observe` descendants do. -/

/-- A decidable property failing somewhere below `n` has a witness below `n` (§40, search for a
leaf). -/
theorem exists_lt_not_of_not_forall {p : Nat → Prop} [DecidablePred p] :
    ∀ n, ¬ (∀ r < n, p r) → ∃ r < n, ¬ p r
  | 0, h => absurd (fun r hr => absurd hr (Nat.not_lt_zero r)) h
  | n + 1, h => by
    by_cases hn : p n
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hp⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall n fun h' => h fun r hr => by
        rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hr with hr | rfl
        · exact h' r hr
        · exact hn
      exact ⟨r, by omega, hp⟩
    · exact ⟨n, Nat.lt_succ_self n, hn⟩

/-- Every place of a well-formed state has a leaf in its footprint (§40, §49.2: parts follow
their parent, so the search for a part without part terminates). -/
theorem exists_mem_footprint {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n q, s.P.length - q < n → q < s.P.length → ∃ l, l ∈ footprint s.P q
  | 0, _, h, _ => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, q, hn, hq => by
    by_cases hleaf : isLeaf s.P q
    · exact ⟨q, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hq, hleaf, hq, .inl rfl⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hpr⟩ := exists_lt_not_of_not_forall _ hleaf
      have hpr : parentOf s.P r = some q := Decidable.of_not_not hpr
      have hlt : ∀ i o, parentOf s.P i = some o → o < i := fun i o h => (hw.parent_lt h).1
      have hqr := hlt r q hpr
      obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hw n r (by omega) hr
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf', -, hlr⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hl
      refine ⟨l, mem_footprint.2 ⟨hlP, hleaf', hlP, .inr ?_⟩⟩
      have hrq : q ∈ chain (parentOf s.P) r := by
        rw [chain_cons hpr hqr]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      rcases hlr with rfl | hlr
      · exact hrq
      · exact chain_trans hlt (l + 1) l (Nat.lt_succ_self l) r hlr q hrq

namespace TransferWitness

/-- Statics of the ownership-cycle counterexample (§47): two leaves owned by frame 0, place 0 and
place 1, both `Init`. -/
def cycStatics : Statics := [((none, none, 0), true), ((none, none, 0), true)]

/-- Initial state of the counterexample (§47). -/
def cyc0 : S3 := S3.init cycStatics

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 0 (§71): place 2 owned by place 0, root
authority 2 held by place 0. -/
def cyc1 : S3 := allocEff cyc0 0 [(none, 0)]

/-- After `alloc` with provider 1 and owner place 2 (§71): place 3 owned by place 2, root
authority 3 held by place 2. -/
def cyc2 : S3 := allocEff cyc1 2 [(none, 0)]

/-- The effect of `transfer(0, 3)` on `cyc2` (§63 `ok` effect): place 2 would be owned by place 3,
which is owned by place 2. -/
def cyc3 : S3 := transferEff cyc2 0 3

/-- `cyc2` is reached from `S3.init cycStatics` by two `alloc` steps (§57, §71). -/
theorem cyc2_reachable : Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 :=
  .step (.step .init (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 0) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))) (KStep.alloc (pr := 1) (ow := 2) (ls := [(none, 0)])
    (AllocStep.ok (by decide) trivial))

/-- `cyc2` satisfies `KInv` and `KAux` (§57, §49.7). -/
theorem cyc2_kInv : KInv cyc2 ∧ KAux cyc2 := kInvAux_of_bounded (by decide)

/-- In `cyc3`, places 2 and 3 own each other and are unusable (§40; §63.9 fails); root authority
2 is active, held by the unusable place 3 and covers the leaf of the unusable place 2. -/
theorem cyc3_cycle : ¬ cyc3.Usable 2 ∧ ¬ cyc3.Usable 3 ∧ cyc3.Active 2 ∧
    OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.holder = .place 3 ∧ 2 ∈ y.footprint) False := by decide

/-- `cyc3` violates holder validity (§49.8), so `WF3`, and `NoDangling` (§54). -/
theorem cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling : ¬ WF3 cyc3 ∧ ¬ NoDangling cyc3 := by
  obtain ⟨hu2, hu3, -, hy⟩ := cyc3_cycle
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hh, hl⟩ := optP_false_iff.1 hy
  have ya : y.active = true := by
    have : OptP (cyc3.A[2]?) (fun y => y.active = true) False := by decide
    rw [hy] at this; exact this
  refine ⟨fun hw => ?_, fun hnd => ?_⟩
  · have := hw.holders 2 y hy ya
    rw [hh] at this; exact hu3 this
  · exact hnd 2 y hy ya 2 hu2 2 (by decide) hl

end TransferWitness

open TransferWitness in
/-- The ownership-cycle run of §63 is rejected by §63.9 alone: under a contract with `DDSound`
(§80), in a reachable state satisfying `KInv ∧ KAux`, `transfer(0, 3)` satisfies §63.1–§63.8, its
destination is not usable in the resulting state (§63.9 fails), so the step is rejected; that
state would violate `KInv` (holder validity §49.8, `cyc3_not_wf3_noDangling`). -/
theorem transfer_cycle_rejected : DDSound Examples.K0 ∧ Reachable Examples.K0 cycStatics cyc2 ∧
    KInv cyc2 ∧ KAux cyc2 ∧
    (cyc2.Usable 0 ∧ cyc2.Usable 3 ∧ HasRight cyc2 .modify 0 ∧ HasRight cyc2 .modify 3 ∧
      SameShape cyc2.P 0 3 ∧ (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 0, cyc2.I l = .init) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 3, cyc2.I l ≠ .init) ∧ ¬ overlap cyc2.P 0 3 ∧
      (∃ g ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, Grounds cyc2 .modify 0 g ∧
        ∀ j ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, ActiveDerivedOutside cyc2 0 j → RightChain cyc2 g j) ∧
      (∀ l ∈ footprint cyc2.P 0, ¬ Examples.K0.Pinned l ∧ cyc2.pin l = false) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ movedDeps cyc2 0, cyc2.Active x) ∧ AnchorOrder cyc3 ∧
      (∀ x ∈ List.range cyc2.A.length, AnchorMoves cyc2 0 x →
        ∀ q ∈ List.range cyc2.P.length, cyc3.Usable q →
          OptP (cyc3.A[x]?) (fun y => y.active = true → y.holder = .place q →
            EffAnchorOK cyc3 x (cyc3.pframe q)) True) ∧
      NoLocalSelfLock cyc2 0 3) ∧

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Access kernel: source leaves after an accepted `transfer` (§63.4, decision Q17)

Owner decision Q17 (validated 2026-11-06): the exemption of §63.4, for "the exercisable authority
on which that right rests and its origin chain", is accepted. With `g` any authority grounding the
`Modify` right over `source` (`Grounds`, §43) and the grounding chain `RightChain s g` (§63.4),
after an accepted `transfer` (§63) from a reachable state (§57):

* (a) every active authority covering a source leaf lies in the grounding chain (§43, §50);
* (b) a read (O9, §66) of a source leaf is rejected through every authority, the leaf being
  `Moved` (§41, §63 `ok` effect, §63.3 disjointness); a write (O10, §67) or a shared write
  (O11, §68) of a source leaf through a strict origin-chain ancestor of `g` is rejected, `g`
  being an active `Modify` descendant covering the leaf (§43 case 3); a second `transfer` of the
  source is rejected (§63.3).

A write or shared write of a source leaf through `g` itself is accepted in some reachable run
(`TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`): §67 and §68 have no `Init` precondition
and `Moved` forbids reads only (§41, §53).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The grounding chain is unchanged by a transfer, which keeps every origin (§63 `ok` effect: no
authority is created or duplicated; §63.4). -/
theorem transfer_rightChain (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    RightChain (transferEff s src dst) = RightChain s := by
  funext g j; simp only [RightChain, (transfer_skel s src dst).ancs]

/-- An effective mode permitting `Modify` on a leaf (§43, cases 1–2): the authority is active,
covers the leaf, has own mode `Modify`, and no active descendant covers the leaf. -/
private theorem allows_modify {s : S3} {g l : Nat} (h : Allows (effective s g l) .modify) :
    ∃ z, s.A[g]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ l ∈ z.footprint ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
      descModes s g l = [] := by
  cases he : effective s g l with
  | none => rw [he] at h; exact h.elim
  | some e =>
    rw [he] at h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, hez⟩ := effective_some he
    have hm : e = .modify := by cases e <;> simp_all [Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
    subst hm
    rcases effOf_cases hez with ⟨h0, hzm⟩ | ⟨-, -, h⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, za, zl, hzm.symm, h0⟩
    · cases h

/-- §43 case 3: an active `Modify` descendant covering the leaf takes away the effective mode. -/
private theorem effective_none_of_modify_desc {s : S3} {a p : Nat}
    (h : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s a p) : effective s a p = none := by
  have hne : descModes s a p ≠ [] := fun e => by rw [e] at h; cases h
  unfold effective
  split
  · split
    · unfold effOf; simp [hne, h]
    · rfl
  · rfl

/-- Core of Q17 (a) (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §43, §50): under `I1`, if `g`
grounds the `Modify` right over `q`, every active authority covering a leaf of `q` is `g` or an
origin-chain ancestor of `g`. A strict descendant of `g` covering the leaf would take away the
effective `Modify` of `g` (§43 cases 3–4); an unrelated one would contradict `I1` (§50). -/
theorem grounds_cover_rightChain {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {q g : Nat} (hg : Grounds s .modify q g)
    {x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) (hlq : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : RightChain s g x := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, zm, h0⟩ := allows_modify (hg.2.2 l hlq)
  by_cases hxg : x = g
  · exact .inl hxg
  by_cases hxa : x ∈ s.ancs g
  · exact .inr hxa
  by_cases hgx : g ∈ s.ancs x
  · have : y.mode ∈ descModes s g l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨x, y, hy, ya, hl, hgx, rfl⟩
    rw [h0] at this; cases this
  · have := (h1 x g y z l hxg hy hz ya za hl zl hgx hxa).2
    rw [zm] at this; cases this

/-- Q17 (a) under `I1` (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §43, §50): after an accepted
`transfer` from a state satisfying `I1`, for every authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over
`source` in the state before the step, every authority active after the step whose footprint
contains a source leaf belongs to the grounding chain of `g` (§63 `ok` effect: activity, origins
and footprints are unchanged). -/
theorem transfer_source_cover_chain_of_i1 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat} (h1 : I1 s)
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
      l ∈ y.footprint → l ∈ footprint s'.P src → RightChain s' g x := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  intro x y l hy ya hl hls
  rw [transfer_rightChain]; rw [transfer_footprint] at hls
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := (transfer_skel s src dst).get hy
  simp only [skel, Prod.mk.injEq] at e
  exact grounds_cover_rightChain h1 hg hy₀ (e.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl) hls

/-- After an accepted `transfer`, every source leaf is `Moved` (§63 `ok` effect; §63.3: a source
leaf is not a destination leaf). -/
theorem transfer_source_moved {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) :
    s'.I l = .moved := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
  have hd : l ∉ footprint s.P dst := fun hd => hpre.disjoint ⟨l, hl, hd⟩
  simp [transferEff, hd, hl]

/-- Q17 (b), reads (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §66.1, §41, §53): after an
accepted `transfer`, a read of a list containing a source leaf is rejected through every
authority, the leaf being `Moved`. No invariant is needed. -/
theorem transfer_source_read_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src)
    {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) (a : Nat) {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : Read3Step a ls s' o) :
    o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.init l hls; rw [transfer_source_moved ht hl] at this; cases this)

/-- After an accepted `transfer`, a strict origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the
`Modify` right over `source` has no effective mode on a source leaf: `g` remains an active
`Modify` descendant covering it (§43 case 3; §63 `ok` effect; §63.4). No invariant is needed. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_effective {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {x l : Nat}
    (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g) (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) : effective s' x l = none := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).effective]
  rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs] at hx; rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, zm, -⟩ := allows_modify (hg.2.2 l hl)
  exact effective_none_of_modify_desc (mem_descModes.2 ⟨g, z, hz, za, zl, hx, zm⟩)

/-- Q17 (b), ordinary writes (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §67.1, §43 case 3):
after an accepted `transfer`, a write of a list containing a source leaf through a strict
origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `source` is
rejected. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_write_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g)
    {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : Write3Step x ls s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.effectiveModify l hls
    rw [transfer_source_anc_effective ht hg hx hl] at this; cases this)

/-- Q17 (b), shared writes (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §68.2, §43 case 3): after
an accepted `transfer`, a shared write of a list containing a source leaf through a strict
origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `source` is
rejected. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g)
    {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : WriteSharedStep k x ls s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => hp.effectivePresent l hls (transfer_source_anc_effective ht hg hx hl))

source has a leaf: that leaf is `Moved`, not `Init` (§63.3). -/
theorem transfer_source_retransfer_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src)
    (dst' : Nat) {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : TransferStep k src dst' s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.srcInit l hl; rw [transfer_source_moved ht hl] at this; cases this)

/-- Decision Q17 (validated 2026-11-06) on reachable states (§57; §63.4, §43, §50, §66–§68): for a
state reachable under `DDSound` (§80) from well-formed statics (§47), an accepted `transfer` of
`src`, and every authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `src` before the step:
(a) every authority active after the step covering a source leaf belongs to the grounding chain of
`g`; (b) for every list `ls` containing a source leaf, a read is rejected through every authority,
and a write or shared write is rejected through every strict origin-chain ancestor of `g`. Writes
through `g` itself are not covered: see `TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`. -/
theorem transfer_source_q17 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) :
    (∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
      l ∈ y.footprint → l ∈ footprint s'.P src → RightChain s' g x) ∧
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → l ∈ footprint s'.P src →
      (∀ (a : Nat) (o : Outcome3 S3), Read3Step a ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s'.ancs g, ∀ o : Outcome3 S3, Write3Step x ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s'.ancs g, ∀ o : Outcome3 S3, WriteSharedStep k x ls s' o → o = .reject) :=
  ⟨transfer_source_cover_chain_of_i1 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).2.1.1 ht hg,
   fun _ _ hls hl => ⟨fun a _ h => transfer_source_read_rejected ht hl hls a h,
    fun _ hx _ h => transfer_source_anc_write_rejected ht hg hl hls hx h,
    fun _ hx _ h => transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected ht hg hl hls hx h⟩⟩

namespace TransferSourceWitness

open Examples

/-- The state after `transfer(0, 1)` from `S3.init st` (§47, §63 `ok` effect): leaf 0 `Moved`,
leaf 1 `Init`. -/
def t1 : S3 := transferEff s0 0 1

/-- Writes through the grounding authority itself are accepted on a moved source leaf (decision
Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §67, §68, §41, §53): under `K0` (`DDSound`, §80) and the
well-formed statics `st` (§47), `S3.init st` is reachable, `transfer(0, 1)` is accepted, root
authority 0 grounds the `Modify` right over place 0, leaf 0 is a `Moved` source leaf afterwards,
and both a write (O10) and a shared write (O11) of leaf 0 through authority 0 are accepted, the
resulting state being reachable. Statement (b) of Q17 therefore fails for O10 and O11 through the

theorem write_through_ground_accepted : DDSound K0 ∧ StaticsOK st ∧ Reachable K0 st s0 ∧
    TransferStep K0 0 1 s0 (.ok t1) ∧ Grounds s0 .modify 0 0 ∧ 0 ∈ footprint t1.P 0 ∧
    t1.I 0 = .moved ∧ Write3Step 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) ∧
    WriteSharedStep K0 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) ∧
    Reachable K0 st (write3Eff t1 [0]) := by
  have ht : TransferStep K0 0 1 s0 (.ok t1) := .ok (by decide)
  have hw : Write3Step 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) := .ok (by decide)
  exact ⟨fun _ _ h => h.elim, by decide, .init, ht, by decide, by decide, by decide, hw,
    .ok (by decide), .step (.step .init (.transfer ht)) (.write hw)⟩

end TransferSourceWitness

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Access kernel: source leaves after an accepted `transfer` (§63.4, decision Q17)

Owner decision Q17 (validated 2026-11-06): the exemption of §63.4, for "the exercisable authority
on which that right rests and its origin chain", is accepted. With `g` any authority grounding the
`Modify` right over `source` (`Grounds`, §43) and the grounding chain `RightChain s g` (§63.4),
after an accepted `transfer` (§63) from a reachable state (§57):

* (a) every active authority covering a source leaf lies in the grounding chain (§43, §50);
* (b) a read (O9, §66) of a source leaf is rejected through every authority, the leaf being
  `Moved` (§41, §63 `ok` effect, §63.3 disjointness); a write (O10, §67) or a shared write
  (O11, §68) of a source leaf through a strict origin-chain ancestor of `g` is rejected, `g`
  being an active `Modify` descendant covering the leaf (§43 case 3); a second `transfer` of the
  source is rejected (§63.3).

A write or shared write of a source leaf through `g` itself is accepted in some reachable run
(`TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`): §67 and §68 have no `Init` precondition
and `Moved` forbids reads only (§41, §53).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- The grounding chain is unchanged by a transfer, which keeps every origin (§63 `ok` effect: no
authority is created or duplicated; §63.4). -/
theorem transfer_rightChain (s : S3) (src dst : Nat) :
    RightChain (transferEff s src dst) = RightChain s := by
  funext g j; simp only [RightChain, (transfer_skel s src dst).ancs]

/-- An effective mode permitting `Modify` on a leaf (§43, cases 1–2): the authority is active,
covers the leaf, has own mode `Modify`, and no active descendant covers the leaf. -/
private theorem allows_modify {s : S3} {g l : Nat} (h : Allows (effective s g l) .modify) :
    ∃ z, s.A[g]? = some z ∧ z.active = true ∧ l ∈ z.footprint ∧ z.mode = .modify ∧
      descModes s g l = [] := by
  cases he : effective s g l with
  | none => rw [he] at h; exact h.elim
  | some e =>
    rw [he] at h
    obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, hez⟩ := effective_some he
    have hm : e = .modify := by cases e <;> simp_all [Allows, OptP, Mode.le]
    subst hm
    rcases effOf_cases hez with ⟨h0, hzm⟩ | ⟨-, -, h⟩
    · exact ⟨z, hz, za, zl, hzm.symm, h0⟩
    · cases h

/-- §43 case 3: an active `Modify` descendant covering the leaf takes away the effective mode. -/
private theorem effective_none_of_modify_desc {s : S3} {a p : Nat}
    (h : Mode.modify ∈ descModes s a p) : effective s a p = none := by
  have hne : descModes s a p ≠ [] := fun e => by rw [e] at h; cases h
  unfold effective
  split
  · split
    · unfold effOf; simp [hne, h]
    · rfl
  · rfl

/-- Core of Q17 (a) (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §43, §50): under `I1`, if `g`
grounds the `Modify` right over `q`, every active authority covering a leaf of `q` is `g` or an
origin-chain ancestor of `g`. A strict descendant of `g` covering the leaf would take away the
effective `Modify` of `g` (§43 cases 3–4); an unrelated one would contradict `I1` (§50). -/
theorem grounds_cover_rightChain {s : S3} (h1 : I1 s) {q g : Nat} (hg : Grounds s .modify q g)
    {x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) (hlq : l ∈ footprint s.P q) : RightChain s g x := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, zm, h0⟩ := allows_modify (hg.2.2 l hlq)
  by_cases hxg : x = g
  · exact .inl hxg
  by_cases hxa : x ∈ s.ancs g
  · exact .inr hxa
  by_cases hgx : g ∈ s.ancs x
  · have : y.mode ∈ descModes s g l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨x, y, hy, ya, hl, hgx, rfl⟩
    rw [h0] at this; cases this
  · have := (h1 x g y z l hxg hy hz ya za hl zl hgx hxa).2
    rw [zm] at this; cases this

/-- Q17 (a) under `I1` (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §43, §50): after an accepted
`transfer` from a state satisfying `I1`, for every authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over
`source` in the state before the step, every authority active after the step whose footprint
contains a source leaf belongs to the grounding chain of `g` (§63 `ok` effect: activity, origins
and footprints are unchanged). -/
theorem transfer_source_cover_chain_of_i1 {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat} (h1 : I1 s)
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) :
    ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
      l ∈ y.footprint → l ∈ footprint s'.P src → RightChain s' g x := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  intro x y l hy ya hl hls
  rw [transfer_rightChain]; rw [transfer_footprint] at hls
  obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := (transfer_skel s src dst).get hy
  simp only [skel, Prod.mk.injEq] at e
  exact grounds_cover_rightChain h1 hg hy₀ (e.2.2.2 ▸ ya) (e.2.2.1 ▸ hl) hls

/-- After an accepted `transfer`, every source leaf is `Moved` (§63 `ok` effect; §63.3: a source
leaf is not a destination leaf). -/
theorem transfer_source_moved {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) :
    s'.I l = .moved := by
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
  have hd : l ∉ footprint s.P dst := fun hd => hpre.disjoint ⟨l, hl, hd⟩
  simp [transferEff, hd, hl]

accepted `transfer`, a read of a list containing a source leaf is rejected through every
authority, the leaf being `Moved`. No invariant is needed. -/
theorem transfer_source_read_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src)
    {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) (a : Nat) {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : Read3Step a ls s' o) :
    o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.init l hls; rw [transfer_source_moved ht hl] at this; cases this)

/-- After an accepted `transfer`, a strict origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the
`Modify` right over `source` has no effective mode on a source leaf: `g` remains an active
`Modify` descendant covering it (§43 case 3; §63 `ok` effect; §63.4). No invariant is needed. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_effective {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {x l : Nat}
    (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g) (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) : effective s' x l = none := by
  obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 ht
  rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).effective]
  rw [(transfer_skel s src dst).ancs] at hx; rw [transfer_footprint] at hl
  obtain ⟨z, hz, za, zl, zm, -⟩ := allows_modify (hg.2.2 l hl)
  exact effective_none_of_modify_desc (mem_descModes.2 ⟨g, z, hz, za, zl, hx, zm⟩)

/-- Q17 (b), ordinary writes (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §67.1, §43 case 3):
after an accepted `transfer`, a write of a list containing a source leaf through a strict
origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `source` is
rejected. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_write_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g)
    {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : Write3Step x ls s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.effectiveModify l hls
    rw [transfer_source_anc_effective ht hg hx hl] at this; cases this)

/-- Q17 (b), shared writes (decision Q17, validated 2026-11-06; §63.4, §68.2, §43 case 3): after
an accepted `transfer`, a shared write of a list containing a source leaf through a strict
origin-chain ancestor of an authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `source` is
rejected. -/
theorem transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) {l : Nat}
    (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src) {ls : List Nat} (hls : l ∈ ls) {x : Nat} (hx : x ∈ s'.ancs g)
    {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : WriteSharedStep k x ls s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => hp.effectivePresent l hls (transfer_source_anc_effective ht hg hx hl))

source has a leaf: that leaf is `Moved`, not `Init` (§63.3). -/

    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) {l : Nat} (hl : l ∈ footprint s'.P src)
    (dst' : Nat) {o : Outcome3 S3} (h : TransferStep k src dst' s' o) : o = .reject :=
  Guarded.det h (.reject fun hp => by
    have := hp.srcInit l hl; rw [transfer_source_moved ht hl] at this; cases this)

/-- Decision Q17 (validated 2026-11-06) on reachable states (§57; §63.4, §43, §50, §66–§68): for a
state reachable under `DDSound` (§80) from well-formed statics (§47), an accepted `transfer` of
`src`, and every authority `g` grounding the `Modify` right over `src` before the step:
(a) every authority active after the step covering a source leaf belongs to the grounding chain of

and a write or shared write is rejected through every strict origin-chain ancestor of `g`. Writes
through `g` itself are not covered: see `TransferSourceWitness.write_through_ground_accepted`. -/
theorem transfer_source_q17 {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} {src dst g : Nat}
    (hdd : DDSound k) (hst : StaticsOK statics) (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (ht : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) (hg : Grounds s .modify src g) :
    (∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority) (l : Nat), s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
      l ∈ y.footprint → l ∈ footprint s'.P src → RightChain s' g x) ∧
    ∀ (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → l ∈ footprint s'.P src →
      (∀ (a : Nat) (o : Outcome3 S3), Read3Step a ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s'.ancs g, ∀ o : Outcome3 S3, Write3Step x ls s' o → o = .reject) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ s'.ancs g, ∀ o : Outcome3 S3, WriteSharedStep k x ls s' o → o = .reject) :=
  ⟨transfer_source_cover_chain_of_i1 (reachable_kinv hdd hst hr).2.1.1 ht hg,
   fun _ _ hls hl => ⟨fun a _ h => transfer_source_read_rejected ht hl hls a h,
    fun _ hx _ h => transfer_source_anc_write_rejected ht hg hl hls hx h,
    fun _ hx _ h => transfer_source_anc_writeShared_rejected ht hg hl hls hx h⟩⟩

namespace TransferSourceWitness

    t1.I 0 = .moved ∧ Write3Step 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) ∧
    WriteSharedStep K0 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) ∧
    Reachable K0 st (write3Eff t1 [0]) := by
  have ht : TransferStep K0 0 1 s0 (.ok t1) := .ok (by decide)
  have hw : Write3Step 0 [0] t1 (.ok (write3Eff t1 [0])) := .ok (by decide)
